items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Well, obviously I played with Howard up until he'd taken sick.

ctx.x: And he was staying at the same time. So it was partly a matter of just being lucky to live near somebody who was a nice guy and played music and helped him.

Well all those old musicians that I called was right around the same neighborhood. Trish Kelly, Willie Parker, Kit Howard, Professor Shalini, Miss Albert Snaya. He was staying at the same neighborhood. He was staying at the same neighborhood. Let me see. Well Rene didn't stay around there, but he used to be around that neighborhood quite often. But all those guys right around that same neighborhood. Followed by the neighborhood. Now Guy, yeah, he used to, I was a banjo player. He used to play banjo and trombone.…
Well that Willie Parker's band then, who was in that? We were telling them about that, but I don't think we got to do something.
